description: Stage 3 — play Snake from understanding. The self (controllable region) seeks the salient food (the static non-board region) and avoids death (off-board rollout), the action chosen by a death-gated Argmax over the learned control basis resp_<A>. Composed from the self/world/board discriminator + control + boundary; no hand-coded aim/seek. Replaces world_prediction.json. Generated by scripts/gen_snake_understanding_seed.py.

microtheory.name: snake_understanding
microtheory.description: self seeks the only not-me/not-board thing (food) without dying — seek falls out of distance+safety

rules.name: mark_salient
rules.comment: The salient target = the static non-board region (axis_kind==invariant AND not ground): in Snake that is the FOOD. LIVE (not a latch): salient is re-evaluated every frame, so a region briefly invariant before it gains velocity (e.g. a head the eye hadn't tracked yet) is UNMARKED once it reads controllable. No hard-coded value; salience from the self/world/board discriminator.

rules.name: choose_action
rules.comment: The self (the SINGLE-cell controllable region — the head; the body is also controllable as it follows me, so pin self to count==1) picks the action whose resp_<A> rollout most shrinks Manhattan distance to the salient food, gated by would_die (off the board, extent from game.h/w). Seek falls out of distance+safety; sets game.chosen_action.
